items.description: Sec. 7.1.1 says the design domain is 'shown in Fig. 6(a)', which is not available. The text only fixes the mesh: 100x100 bilinear quads (Sec. 5; Sec. 8 'fixed domain of 100x100'). With top88's unit square elements this implies a square domain, but no side length or units are stated.
readings: Square domain, 100 x 100 length units (unit-size square elements, top88 convention)
Square domain, 1 x 1 (element size 0.01, rmin kept at 2.4 element widths)

items.entity: modelled region: full structure vs symmetric half
items.description: 'Mid-load' (Fig. 6(a) caption, Sec. 7.1.1) solved with top88 could mean the full beam loaded at mid-span on the 100x100 grid. It could also mean top88's default half-MBB setup, where the grid is one symmetric half of a 2:1 beam. The text does not say which.
readings: 100x100 grid is the whole structure, with the load at its mid-span
100x100 grid is one symmetric half of a 200x100 beam, with the symmetry edge on the load line (top88 default MBB with nelx = nely = 100)

items.description: The only label is 'Mid-load' (Fig. 6(a) caption, Sec. 7.1.1). Which edge or point carries the load is shown only in Fig. 6(a).
readings: Top edge, x = 0.5 L (y = L)
Bottom edge, x = 0.5 L (y = 0)
Domain centre, x = 0.5 L, y = 0.5 L
Top-left corner node (x = 0, y = L) of a half-symmetric model, i.e. mid-span of the mirrored full beam (top88 default)

items.description: The load direction is given only by the arrow in Fig. 6(a); the text never states it.
readings: Vertical, downward (-y), as in top88's F = -1
Vertical, upward (+y): same layout and compliance as downward
Horizontal (+/-x)

items.description: No load value appears anywhere (Secs. 4.1, 5, 7.1.1). Only relative compliance errors are reported (Table 1).
readings: Unit load |F| = 1 (top88 default)
Another magnitude P (e.g., a value possibly printed in Fig. 6(a))

items.description: The text does not say whether the load is a single nodal force or is spread over several nodes or an edge segment; this is shown only in Fig. 6(a).
readings: Concentrated force on a single node
Uniform load over a short segment around the load point (about 2-5 elements, i.e. 0.02-0.05 L)

items.description: The boundary conditions are only 'shown in Fig. 6(a)' (Sec. 7.1.1). The text gives no support locations or extents.
readings: Single nodes at the bottom-left (0,0) and bottom-right (L,0) corners
Small patches of a few nodes (about 0.02-0.05 L) at both bottom corners
Entire left (x = 0) and right (x = L) edges
Half model: whole symmetry edge x = 0 plus the single bottom-right corner node (L,0) (top88 default)

items.description: The text does not say whether the supports are pins, rollers, symmetry rollers or clamps; this is shown only in Fig. 6(a).
readings: Pin (ux = uy = 0) at one corner and roller (uy = 0) at the other
Pins (ux = uy = 0) at both supports
Symmetry rollers (ux = 0) on the cut edge plus a vertical roller (uy = 0) at the far bottom corner (half-MBB)
Clamped edges (ux = uy = 0 on whole edges)

items.description: No solid or void non-design regions are mentioned for this example (Secs. 5, 7.1.1). Plain top88 has none, but Fig. 6(a) might show pads at the load or supports.
readings: None: all 100x100 elements are designable
Small solid (rho = 1) pads under the load point and/or at the supports

items.description: Eq. (3) introduces E1, but no value is given anywhere.
readings: E1 = 1 (non-dimensional, top88 default)
A physical value, e.g. E1 = 210 GPa

items.description: Eq. (3) uses E0 for the void phase but gives no value. Note that in the cited top88 code, E0 is the solid modulus and Emin is the void modulus.
readings: E0 = 1e-9 E1 (top88 Emin)

items.description: Never mentioned. Sec. 4 gives only the SIMP interpolation with p = 3.
readings: nu = 0.3 (top88 default)

items.description: Sec. 4 says bilinear quadrilateral elements but not plane stress vs plane strain, nor the thickness. top88 implicitly uses plane stress with unit thickness.
readings: Plane stress, unit thickness
Plane strain
Plane stress with non-unit thickness t (scales compliance only)

items.description: Sec. 5 gives only the top88 flags {penal=3, rmin=2.4, ft=1} and never says which filter this is. In top88, ft=1 is the sensitivity filter (ft=2 is the density filter) and rmin is in element widths.
readings: Sensitivity filter, rmin = 2.4 element widths (top88 ft = 1)
Density filter, rmin = 2.4 element widths

items.description: No update scheme, move limit, convergence tolerance or iteration cap is given for the top88 runs. maxit = 100 is listed only for TOPress (Sec. 5).
readings: top88 default OC (move 0.2, damping 0.5), stop when max density change < 0.01, no iteration cap
Same OC but capped at 100 iterations (as for TOPress)
MMA with a fixed iteration count
